data.long_meaning: Asheesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ashī’ meaning 'wisdom'. This name is a tribute to the God of Wisdom, Lord Buddha, and is believed to bestow the bearer with intelligence and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Asheesh is also identified with Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
